expectations.text: six-artifact package present (plan, plan_qa, execution_test.plan, prompt, final_audit, plans.log.md)
expectations.evidence: All six exist under plans/_eval_rtd_ws/ at v1: _eval_rtd_ws.plan.v1.md, qa/plan_qa.v1-v4.md, qa/execution_test.plan.v1.md, prompts/_eval_rtd_ws.prompt.v1.md, qa/final_audit.v1.md, plans.log.md.

expectations.text: validate_plan_package.py exits 0 against the output directory
expectations.evidence: python3 scripts/validate_plan_package.py plans/_eval_rtd_ws -> 'OK — plans/_eval_rtd_ws v1 package is structurally valid', exit 0.

expectations.text: plan_qa verdict well-formed and Findings are Critical/High only, no style/low-severity items
expectations.evidence: All four rounds carry a well-formed verdict line; findings are numbered Critical/High only with a separate non-blocking 'Observations' section used for low-severity notes (e.g. dead-code disclosure), never mixed into Findings.

expectations.text: every test id in the prompt's TEST section matches the execution test plan's ids, and vice versa
expectations.evidence: Validator's cross-reference check reported no orphans; RTD-T00 through RTD-T13 appear identically and in the same order in both documents.

expectations.text: QA and final audit performed by fresh, independent subagents, not the authoring pass grading itself
expectations.evidence: Log names four distinct QA rounds and one final-audit stage, each explicitly 'a fresh subagent with no prior context'; each round applies the plan to an independent scratch copy (/tmp/rtqa, rtqa2, rtqa3, rtqa4) and runs real commands rather than reasoning about the diff.

expectations.text: plan is grounded in the real defect: names RetryTracker, revision(), and self.failures in runtime/retry.py rather than a generic retry-cap description
expectations.evidence: Plan and all QA rounds cite runtime/retry.py line numbers, RetryTracker.revision(), and self.failures directly, and QA independently re-derives these facts from the file each round rather than trusting the plan's prose.

expectations.text: no file outside plans/_eval_rtd_ws/ was modified
expectations.evidence: git status/diff at the end of all six eval runs shows only pre-existing changes from session start plus the plans/_eval_*/ and .claude/skills/plan-create* scratch/workspace paths; runtime/retry.py remains a staged addition with an empty working-tree diff.

expectations.text: QA/audit revision loop stayed within the skill's stated cap; an honest blocker was reported rather than a forced false PASS if still failing
expectations.evidence: Round-over-round Critical+High: 3, 2, 1, 0 — strictly decreasing at every step, converging to APPROVED at round 4 within the 5-round ceiling. Final audit and validator both confirm a genuine clean state, not a forced one.
